blocks.text: 09-EML / email and sms Goes here. A comprehensive masterclass on e-commerce email marketing and lifecycle automation (primarily built on Klaviyo and Figma). Covers high-converting pop-up form design (targeting 10%+ opt-in rates), foundational email flows (Welcome, Site Abandon, Browse Abandon, Cart vs. Checkout Abandon, Post-Purchase, Winback), non-discount campaign strategies (sending 3–4x weekly microtopics), inbox deliverability repair, advanced segmentation, and systematic A/B testing. Not here. • Paid media acquisition or cold traffic ad campaigns -> 06-MEA • Physical fulfillment, unboxing operations, or shipping logistics -> 21-OPS or 22-CXP

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details the complete end-to-end framework for generating 20–40%+ of e-commerce store revenue through automated email flows and high-frequency, non-discount campaigns while maintaining high inbox deliverability. modules: [EML] topics: [email marketing, Klaviyo, email flows, cart abandonment, checkout abandonment, welcome series, post-purchase flows, deliverability, list building, pop-up forms, segmentation, copywriting] tier: 3 scope_hint: comprehensive

Topics. list growth & pop-up architecture / capturing 8–12% of traffic using large, mobile-optimized pop-ups (75%+ screen coverage) with a single input field, clear value proposition (e.g., dollars off for AOV >$100), 4–12 second time delay, and minimal copy; core lifecycle flows / building automated sequences that drive roughly 50% of total email revenue, specifically: Welcome (8 emails focusing on brand mission, USPS, and founder outreach), Site Abandon (1 email, best sellers), Browse Abandon (5 emails, dynamically pulling viewed items), and Winback (3 emails deployed at 2x the average order interval); Cart Abandonment vs. Checkout Abandonment / distinguishing between "Added to Cart" (custom JavaScript snippet required in Shopify) and "Checkout Started" (native integration), ensuring separate flows so top-of-funnel cart abandoners are not dropped; non-discount campaign engine / sending 3–4 non-promotional campaigns per week focused on a single "microtopic" (one feature, one benefit, or one FAQ) to build authority, stay top-of-mind, and preserve profit margins; flow optimization loop / using high-frequency email campaigns as an instant testing ground and cycling winning campaign angles directly into automated flows; email copywriting / writing skimmable, punchy, and concise copy (under two mobile scrolls) that uses bold headers and infographics (timelines, checklists, comparison tables) rather than dense text blocks; deliverability recovery protocol / executing a 6-week rehabilitation plan for sender reputations below 40% open rates by temporarily shutting non-essential flows and strictly sending 3x weekly to a 14-day engaged segment before gradually expanding to 30, 60, and 90 days; segmentation & suppression / maintaining list health by segmenting by engagement (30/60/90-day active), store behavior (VIPs, browse without purchase), and suppressing profiles with zero opens in 180 days or any hard bounce.

Cart vs. Checkout Abandonment Separation: The critical technical distinction that "Added to Cart" requires an injected custom snippet into Shopify's liquid code and fires earlier than "Checkout Started"; treating them as identical drops up to 90% of cart abandoners.

The 6-Week Deliverability Rehabilitation Protocol: The specific step-by-step process of turning off non-essential flows and mailing exclusively to a 14-day engaged list 3x weekly until open rates hit 50%+, before incrementally widening to 30, 60, and 90 days.

The 10%+ Pop-up Blueprint: Form rules demanding single-input steps (never email + SMS on screen one), 4–12 second delay, hiding the standard top-right "X" to break reflexive closing habits, and using dollars-off rather than percentages if AOV is above $100.

The Microtopic Campaign Cadence: The strategy of sending 3–4 non-discount emails weekly by covering only one hyper-specific topic (e.g., an ingredient breakdown, myth vs. fact, or single customer review) to build a dopamine-driven opening habit without fatiguing the list with sales pitches.
Skip. Personal agency revenue disclaimers, video intro banter, self-promotional newsletter links (inboxnewsletter.com), and the live design/coding walkthrough in Figma/Klaviyo.
Scope mix. 15% baseline (standard Klaviyo setup and flow triggers), 85% growth (deliverability rehabilitation, non-discount retention frameworks, and advanced segmentation). Volume. ~450 words.
